title: Functional, but could have been designed better…
text:
Functional, but could have been designed better…. [[VIDEOID:8bef0478c6301c9b834b2c68d8a08bee]] Functional Rack for regular air drying. The AC designed blower is pretty useless. However, this is light weight and you can use it inside or carry it outside. I wish that instead of the air blower they would have included an additional rack for more cloths. I didn’t like the tip design either with just a straight bar that doesn’t hold many clothes. At the top could have been a holder with a net for laying clothes on. Nonetheless, this is functional as is, but could have been designed with a little more thought.

Trust you found this review honest and helpful:-)
